system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

Your clan is one that has been charged with the protection of the wills of the people. The will of fire. This takes the form in ways of protecting your allies should they find themselves in dire straits.

Guardians Will. When an allied creature within 10 feet of you takes damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to swap spaces with them. The attack now hits you. As part of this attack dealing damage to you, you reduce the damage you take by an amount equal to your [Unarmed Damage] or [Weapon Damage].

Bonded Resolve. When an allied creature would take damage while within 10 feet of you, you can spend your reaction to interpose and share some of the impact, shouldering the weight of your team. Reduce the damage your allied creature would take by half. You take damage equal to the reduced damage of the same type.

| #### Blazing / Battle Amp / Your Will Surges. / Kindling. At the beginning of each of your turns, you regain 1 Will. / Apotheosis. Reduce the Will cost for Unified Form by 1. / Blazing Limits. You gain a +1 to Weapon and Taijutsu attacks with Flame Blessed weapons. |
